_: Thu 15 Oct 2026 · community slot. Rebuilt 9 Oct after Chenson said the McDonough festival is next week. READ 9 Oct 2026 on the City of McDonough calendar (mcdonoughga.org/Calendar.aspx): Fall Festival on the Square, Oct 17, 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM, McDonough Square Proper, 5 Griffin St, McDonough, GA 30253. Also read on the Visit Henry County events calendar: Smoke & Mirrors Truck and Car Show (Oct 17, 9am to 1pm, Sweet Auburn BBQ McDonough, 1828 Jonesboro Road, McDonough); Fall Market (Oct 17-18, 10 AM to 5 PM in the description, Tanger Outlet Center, 1000 Tanger Drive Suite 211, Locust Grove). Earliest is Oct 17, after the Oct 15 publish. Dropped from the first draft: Oktoberfest cornhole and disc golf (no times listed, and four items overflowed the card). The Oct 15 Ladies Night Out on the Square is the same day as publish, so it is left off.
headline:
Fall Festival Is Saturday
On The Square
titan_line: Echo, McDonough's Fall Festival on the Square is this Saturday, Oct 17, and two more things are on the same day.

items.title: Fall Festival on the Square
items.detail: McDonough Square, 5 Griffin Street, McDonough. 12pm to 4pm.

items.title: Smoke & Mirrors Truck Show
items.detail: Sweet Auburn BBQ, 1828 Jonesboro Road, McDonough. 9am to 1pm.

items.title: Fall Market
items.detail: Tanger Outlet Center, 1000 Tanger Drive, Locust Grove. 10am to 5pm.

echo_line: A festival, a truck show and a market. …Oh, all in one Saturday. I'd start on the Square.
